Who is Clobber?

Clobb|species=|altmode=Tank|combinesinto=|headmaster=|targetmaster=|powermaster=|godmaster=|brainmaster=|mini-con=|micron=|titan master=|transtector=|headmaster partner=|targetmaster partner=|powermaster partner=|mini-con partner=|micron partner=|titan master partner=|components=|cassette=|pilot=|driver=|gender=Female|hair=|eye=Red|age=Unknown|birthdate=|deathdate=|status=Live|family=Primus|loves=|nationality=|affiliation=Decepticons(formely), Autobots|occupation=Help Desepticons(formely)|rank=|height=|headheight=|length=|mecha=|vessels commanded=|vessels crewed=}}Clobber is a female Autobot and former Decepticon in Transformers: Cyberverse.

Her best friend is Lockdown, and she's a huge, intimidating bruiser, capable of withstanding tremendous damage and retaliating with devastating punches when she's not using her hovertank mode to simply roll over the enemy.
